already_running.description: true when another prune holds the lease: nothing was done.

older_than.description: null when no age is configured: no decisions are deleted (expired cache rows still are).

deleted.description: With dry_run, what would be deleted.

kept_current.description: Decisions older than the age that were kept because they are current (their fingerprint is the current effective fingerprint of their scope for a configured policy).

skipped_policies.description: Policies skipped because their fingerprint computation hit the unreadable marker.
